defaultDescription: Andrew Hoffman builds cross-platform mobile apps and connected systems with .NET MAUI, C#, REST APIs, and SQL.

header.headline: Care in every layer.
header.intro: I’m Andrew Hoffman, a .NET developer building cross-platform mobile apps and the systems behind them. Thoughtful interfaces. Reliable connections. Practical engineering.

about.intro: I enjoy turning complex requirements into straightforward mobile experiences. I work with clients to understand what they need, make sound development decisions, and build a product that matches their expectations.

experience.description: I was responsible for a large front end and backend update on an existing Xamarin Forms app, as well as migrating that Xamarin Forms app to .NET MAUI. I was also responsible for updating and maintaining an existing .NET Core API that serviced the Forms and MAUI apps. I was also in charge of creating, updating, and maintaining build and release pipelines for the Apps and API in Azure Devops.
contributions: Updated an existing Xamarin Forms application and migrated it to .NET MAUI.
Maintained the .NET Core API supporting the mobile applications.
Created and maintained app and API build and release pipelines in Azure DevOps.

experience.description: I created an app in Xamarin Forms that recorded screenshots on a users phone and then exported those screenshots into a Powerpoint slideshow. I also added new features to a Xamarin Forms app that allows users to complete inspections on equipment while out in the field. I also create a suite of apps in Xamarin Forms for warehouse workers to put and pick merchandise without requiring terminal access.
contributions: Built a Xamarin Forms app that captured phone screenshots and exported them to PowerPoint.
Added features to mobile equipment-inspection tools.
Created warehouse apps for putting and picking merchandise without terminal access.

experience.description: I was responsible for the creation of a Xamarin Forms app that allows users to complete inspections on equipment while out in the field, along with it's associated API. I also continued and finalized development on a Xamarin Forms app that displayed real time information from drilling wells.
contributions: Built a Xamarin Forms equipment-inspection app and its supporting API.
Continued and completed a mobile application displaying real-time drilling-well information.

experience.description: I began development on a Xamarin Forms app that displayed real time information from drilling wells. I also created a SPA site that described a company led initiative. I also created a WPF desktop application for troubleshooting why something isn't working based on the 5 Whys Process.
contributions: Began development of a Xamarin Forms app for real-time drilling-well information.
Created a single-page site for a company initiative.
Built a WPF troubleshooting application based on the Five Whys process.

contact.intro: Have a project in mind, or an opportunity on your team? I’m open to discussing mobile apps, connected systems, and how I can help.
